harness_changes.change: any performance.* field satisfies the warning; a figure with no readable face still has posture
a project's style anchor is evaluatable — the one image every other image inherits
a colour word in a content field far from every declared swatch is warned about
a prompt naming an asset that holds a selected sheet must reference it
capped question: is this the same object as its sheet, not a second version
asset sheets are asked lighting_rules and excluded, as cuts already were
a fact that cannot be seen is answered as such, excluded from the score, counted in coverage
'none available' and friends are refused in any field; clearing says it properly
a style reference carries no subject, so it does not deepen content lineage
sheet_unreferenced applies to sheets only; for a cut the scope is the declaration
the lighting rule is a contract, not a preference
feet are their own capped question; hands name 8x nearest-neighbour
a fault copied from a sheet is routed to the sheet, not charged to the frame
no aggregate pixel measure separates a fifth ink from ink-to-paper blend; HARNESS.md 4b
a cut names the view it is staged on; a sheet shows a place along one axis only
the budget counts identical prompts; a repair that changed the ask is new work
a record answered against an older rubric says so; reanswer.py carries it forward

harness_changes.class: the detail that is not there to have
harness_changes.change: measure first: under ~60px a hand cannot carry fingers, so not_visible with the size
not_visible counted toward coverage in the evaluated flag; it looped forever without it
one capped question asked the other way round: what is in the frame that the cut never cast
a chained frame is asked whether it continued the frame it was built from
chain every frame of a transformation onto the one that established the form, not onto its predecessor
a declared shot size is expanded into how much of the frame the subject fills
the duplicate check runs before the status the loop acts on is read
can_retry counts takes sharing the latest prompt, matching the budget rule
a style token phrased as a prohibition carries an instruction to answer it by counting, not looking
within-frame tonal patches fail too: a fixed grid dilutes a localised fault; HARNESS.md 4b
one capped question: is every object drawn from the same horizon
camera.height, lens, movement and depth of field reach the prompt; they were being discarded
the bible says how a transparent thing is printed; measured, it moved the ice from 2.34x the cloth to 0.66x
a palette entry nothing in the production ever met, including the anchor, is not a check
a judge record goes stale with the definition too; carrying only facts left takes unevaluated
counting needs two or three controls of comparable ink density; a blank region makes anything look graded

open: set policy.require_stranger=true for autonomous runs: the host must not be the only evaluator
rewrite `continues` and the base-reference instruction: same world (identity, state, geography, props), not same framing
the head renders as a cut gem in five takes; try a reference image of a rough block rather than more prompt text
add tests for undeclared, viewpoint, continues, feet, base_from, rubric drift, prompt-scoped can_retry
move the prompt builder and reanswer into backend/studio
only then: story 2 in a different style to test transfer

reassessment_2026_09_23.finding: self-evaluation is generous by ~0.5 consistently; the gate is sound once a stranger record exists
